.. change::
    :tags: performance, sql
    :tickets: 13617

    The comparator class that :class:`.TypeDecorator` generates in order to
    combine :class:`.TypeDecorator.Comparator` with the comparator of its
    ``impl`` type is now created once per ``impl`` comparator class and then
    reused, rather than being created as a new class for every column
    expression against a :class:`.TypeDecorator` type.  Creating a class is
    comparatively expensive and each such class also adds work for Python's
    cyclic garbage collector.
